description: Claude Code hook-group manifest consumed by invoke_dispatch_claude.py (one process per (event, matcher) group) and expanded by build/scripts/generate_hooks_events.py back to per-hook entries so the generated Copilot tree is unchanged. file is relative to .claude/hooks/. timeout/statusMessage preserve the pre-consolidation per-hook registration values for generator fidelity. copilotMatcher overrides the group matcher for Copilot shim generation only. copilotExclude must be a strict boolean (ADR-085 Decision 7 item 1); when true it omits the shim from Copilot expansion entirely and requires the group to declare surface: plugin (item 2), plus non-empty copilotExcludeIssue and copilotExcludeDecision metadata naming the authorizing issue (item 3) and the ADR that owns the exclusion judgment (item 4). invoke_dispatch_claude.py ignores copilotExclude* fields entirely, so Claude Code keeps running the shim unchanged (item 6). advisory: true marks a Stop group whose hook only informs the user. The registration in hooks.json repeats it as --advisory, because the launcher must know the failure policy when this manifest cannot be loaded: every launcher failure path exits 0 with one stderr line, and the hook's systemMessage prints as a systemMessage document (REQ-048 AC-26, AC-27). tests/hooks/test_dispatch_groups_parity.py pins the two to agree. plugin-stop-1-reflect_nudge is a NON-SECURITY exclusion, owner decision D20 (REQ-048 AC-21). Its friction signals read Claude Code's wording, not a Copilot guard's, so no protection is lost on Copilot and the ADR-085 security judgment is not engaged. Item 2: Copilot's generated plugin hooks.json loses the shim; the Claude plugin source (src/claude/hooks/hooks.json) and the unaffected .claude/settings.json keep it. Item 3: issue #5817 authorizes the hook, not #5013. Item 4: copilotExcludeDecision is ADR-084 (rule 2a), not ADR-085, because the exclusion is a scope choice and not a security judgment. Item 5, residual risk: Copilot users get no nudge, and nothing else changes for them. Item 7, reintroduction: flip the field to false when Copilot documents an advisory Stop output field and a transcript_path, and the hook has its own passing gate there. This replaces the eight #5013 gates, which describe a deleted guard. Item 8, cleanup: the exclusion is conditional, so removing the dead Copilot generation path is owed only if the exclusion becomes permanent. Item 9, tests: tests/hooks/test_plugin_stop_registration.py holds the Copilot absence regression, the Claude presence regression, and the group's advisory/registration agreement; tests/build_scripts/test_dispatch_expansion.py holds the strict-boolean validation.
